lessons.observation: A truthful unified register still needs a normalized receipt boundary before external evidence can be evaluated consistently.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: State vocabulary and owner summary worked; provider-specific evidence remained unstructured.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: No shared exact receipt schema, digest, time window, or required-check policy existed.
lessons.product_change_made: Added exact nonsecret receipt validation and preview-only promotion.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added component rules and tests that reject stale, tampered, secret-bearing, write-bearing, activation-bearing, or incomplete evidence.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer integrations that reduce owner burden without conflating evidence, authorization, and mutation.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Recovery must preserve receipt digest rules, exact source binding, and preview-only behavior.

lessons.observation: A valid hand-built inventory can still drift across repeated freezes unless generation is deterministic and checkable.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: The V14 inventory validated; creation was not exposed as one reusable command.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: Generation and validation were separate release-operator steps.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added deterministic generator/check mode and receipt field verification.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Select release-governance improvements that remove manual evidence drift.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Candidate and final freezes must regenerate then check exact payload inventory before archive creation.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which exact GitHub repository and Render service are canonical?
Which read-only evidence adapter should be connected first after those identities are known?
next_version_learning_priorities: Canonical repository and deployment evidence binding
